data.commands: After ledger start, run python3 explorations/runs/EXPLORE-SEMANTIC-PROOF-TRANSFER-A-1/run.py once. It uses retained supervisor for official checker <unchanged slice>, then retained LazyLean --engine subst --jobs 1 <unchanged slice> and --engine kam --jobs 1 <unchanged slice> with LL_KAM_MODE=3; each process has 120-second and 2-GiB limits and positive process-group RSS/cleanup controls. Preserve any retries under a new attempt directory.
data.controls: Fresh official Lean must ACCEPT unchanged init-04; prior 2026-09-28 official Lean and Nanoda ACCEPTs are dated context only. LazyLean must produce a recognized checker outcome under its retained fail-closed classifier; positive RSS, no timeout or memory breach, and complete cleanup are required. An accepted official control plus a recognized LazyLean semantic rejection on compatible input is a candidate SIGNAL, not semantic authority. Matching accepts are NO_SIGNAL for this exact sample. Import/format rejection, invalid control or unavailable observation is INCONCLUSIVE.
data.question: For retained init-04, does unchanged real-proof NDJSON accepted by official Lean and Nanoda on 2026-09-28 also receive recognized acceptance from retained LazyLean substitution and KAM-mode-3 under fresh supervised execution, and is there a controlled verdict difference?
data.sample: One fixed previously ACCEPT_BOTH real declaration: init-04 (15070 bytes, SHA-256 6017b3dcdcfff927cb2eee720a2c940183257dec49661ff800dcce0ebad4b73c); selected by ascending slice byte size then path among nine prior ACCEPT_BOTH cases. No replacement after outcome. Exactly three planned fresh cells: official Lean control, LazyLean substitution, LazyLean KAM-mode-3.
